name: Gia Lai food guide
summary: Pleiku starts with two-bowl pho and grilled chicken with bamboo rice. Krông Pa beef, fermented crab noodles, and jar wine are the highland table. The coast, former Bình Định, is a different meal.
body: Eat in Pleiku when the lake is the trip. Breakfast is two-bowl pho along Nguyễn Văn Trỗi: dry noodles in one bowl, broth in the other, and the black fermented-soybean sauce Go Vietnam ties to Gia Lai. From noon, the Vietnam News Agency’s window, the plate is charcoal chicken with sticky rice from a bamboo tube, in Tân Sơn and on Lê Duẩn, Phạm Ngọc Thạch, and Hàn Thuyên.

The highland table continues with Krông Pa beef, beef on bamboo skewers, Jrai cassava leaf, river fish from the Sê San, Pleiku coffee, and jar wine. Điện Hồng, on Nguyễn Thiện Thuật and Trần Phú, is the night street Vietnam.vn opened on 22 April 2026. It sells the pho again, plus noodles, grilled dishes, and snacks. Stall hours there are Check on arrival.

After the 2025 merger the province also holds the old Bình Định coast. Vietnam Tourism’s culinary journey puts bánh xèo tôm nhảy, bánh hỏi lòng heo, bánh ít lá gai, and bánh hồng on that side, and Vietnam.vn adds tré. Quy Nhơn is where that article sends you for lobster, crab, squid, and shellfish. Those coastal plates are not the Pleiku breakfast.

Chicken prices in print are about 200,000 VND (VnExpress International), about 250,000 VND (VnExpress, 29 May 2016), and about 300,000 VND (Vietnam News Agency, 21 December 2022). Pho portions in print run about 35,000–60,000 VND.
specialtiesLead: Start with two-bowl pho and the grilled chicken. Krông Pa beef, the Sê San fish, jar wine, and the coastal plates follow.

sections.heading: Pleiku and the highlands
paragraphs: These are the Pleiku and highland plates. Where two articles disagree, both figures stay. A door clock that was not printed is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Two-bowl pho
spots.note: Dry noodles in one bowl, broth in the other, with black fermented-soybean sauce. Go Vietnam, 13 August 2026, puts the morning trade on Nguyễn Văn Trỗi from early morning through midday, and some shops all day. Printed prices run about 35,000–60,000 VND.

spots.name: Grilled chicken with bamboo rice
spots.address: Tân Sơn, Lê Duẩn, Phạm Ngọc Thạch, Hàn Thuyên
spots.note: Charcoal chicken and bamboo-tube sticky rice. Printed serving prices are about 200,000, 250,000, and 300,000 VND. The Vietnam News Agency says noon to late evening. Peanut-sesame salt and lime-salt-pepper are both in print.

spots.name: Sun-dried beef
spots.note: Krông Pa beef, dried and grilled, with yellow ant salt. Sun and charcoal are both in print. A 2016 gift price is about 500,000 VND a kilogram. A plated price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Beef on bamboo skewers
spots.note: Mountain beef on bamboo skewers, with basil. VnExpress, 29 May 2016. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fermented crab noodles
spots.note: Fermented field-crab broth. Vietnam.vn describes a black Pleiku bowl with măng le and a duck egg. VnExpress International traces the dish to Bình Định. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled pork
spots.note: Skewered or whole grilled pork with bamboo rice at Teng village, Tân Sơn. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Wild boar
spots.note: Named among Gia Lai’s known plates on 22 July 2022. A method is Check on arrival. The Sê San fish called sọc dưa is a different name.

spots.name: Stir-fried cassava leaves
spots.note: Young white or red cassava leaf, bitter then sweet. Jrai cooking in Krông Pa. The green tuber leaf is not eaten. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cassava-leaf soup
spots.note: Stir-fried cassava leaf loosened with rice-flour water. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Anam Tbung
spots.note: Rice flour with offal or meat, for a funeral, a wedding, a death anniversary, or a new house. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Braised fish
spots.note: Named with the cassava leaf and ant salt on a Jrai meal by the Ba river. A method is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bitter eggplant with chicken offal
spots.note: Young bitter eggplant and chicken offal in banana leaf, grilled. Western Gia Lai, 22 December 2025. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled river fish
spots.note: River fish on charcoal, no marinade, with chili salt, lá é salt, or ant salt. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dried Sê San anchovy
spots.nameVi: Cá cơm khô sông Sê San
spots.note: Sun-dried Sê San anchovy, fried for rice. A 2022 quote is 110,000 VND a kilogram. A current price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dried-anchovy salad
spots.note: The same dried anchovy, fried and tossed with green mango and herbs. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Anchovy rice crackers
spots.note: Seasoned anchovy dried on rice paper. A 2022 price is 5,000 VND a sheet. A current price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Anchovy fish sauce
spots.note: Fermented when the rains stop the drying. A 2022 quote is 80,000 VND a litre. A current price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Biển Hồ shrimp
spots.note: Named as a Gia Lai plate, and described seasoned on rice paper. Another preparation is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pleiku coffee
spots.note: The local brew in Pleiku’s long-running cafes. A cup price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Jar wine
spots.note: Jar wine, also called rượu ghè. Printed jar prices in one Tết article are 250,000–700,000 VND. A glass is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: The coast
paragraphs: Vietnam Tourism’s culinary journey treats the post-merger province as highland plus the old Bình Định coast. Eat these in that coastal belt, not on Nguyễn Văn Trỗi.

The same journey names lobster, crab, squid, and shellfish in Quy Nhơn and nearby fishing villages, at Hàm Tử port, Đầm market, and Khu 2 market. A preparation for each was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Jumping-shrimp pancake
spots.note: Crisp pancake with small Bình Định freshwater shrimp. Squid and beef versions are also named. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Rice sheets with pork offal
spots.note: Fine rice sheets, scallion fat, and pork offal, with a blood-and-minced-pork porridge. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ramie-leaf dumpling
spots.note: Black glutinous dumpling with lá gai, coconut, and mung bean. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pink coconut cake
spots.note: Glutinous rice, sugar, and coconut, eaten with tea. The English heading also says rose cake. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fermented pork parcel
spots.note: Fermented pork in leaf and straw, from the former Bình Định area. Ready in two or three days. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Streets
paragraphs: Two eating streets. They are not extra dishes. Stall prices are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nguyễn Văn Trỗi
spots.note: The daytime two-bowl pho street. Go Vietnam, 13 August 2026, says early morning through midday, with some shops open all day. A door’s clock is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Điện Hồng food street
spots.address: Nguyễn Thiện Thuật–Trần Phú, Điện Hồng ward
spots.note: Vietnam.vn records the opening on 22 April 2026, 73 lots, 19 of them souvenirs and OCOP and 54 of them food: two-bowl pho, noodles, grilled dishes, and snacks. Parking is free on that account. Stall hours are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Breakfast is two-bowl pho on Nguyễn Văn Trỗi. Go Vietnam says the shops run from early morning through midday, and some stay open all day. Coffee is the other morning cup, in Pleiku, with no street printed. A door’s clock is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Gia Lai food guide — two-bowl pho, then the highlands
seoDescription: Pleiku breakfast is two-bowl pho. Lunch is grilled chicken with bamboo rice. Krông Pa beef and the coastal pancakes are separate meals.
